title: Invent new software materials
principle: Powerful interface innovation comes from discovering new metaphors and reifying them as materials—especially when text and files are too low-level for the job.
procedure: State the job that current materials (text spans, files) cannot express cleanly.
Ask: discrete or continuous? hierarchical? what weight/salience does each unit carry?
Borrow a proven metaphor from another medium (timeline clips, spatial boards) only if its physics transfer.
Prototype the material’s affordances before chrome or marketing.
Reject materials that are only labels on the same old feature bag.
examplePrompts:
Invent a software material for <domain>.

Current weak abstraction: <e.g. flat URL history list>
Questions to answer: discrete vs continuous; hierarchy; weight; salience.
Propose: name, laws of physics, 3 operations, 1 metaphor borrow (or none).
Do not ship a feature list.
promptWhy: Blocks feature-list answers; demands a reified material.
tips: Linus sketches browsing history as a clips-and-timeline reel instead of a URL list.
Tools for thought may need materials above text but below files.
Cite: thesephist.com/posts/materials/ and latent essay for LM interfaces.

workedExamples.title: Browsing history as reel
workedExamples.before: History = flat URL list; reopen closed tab is a special feature.
workedExamples.after: History = timeline of page clips; reopen = select a span and restore.
workedExamples.body: Linus’s sketch: visiting pages records clips; Enter starts a new track; edit/share sessions like video. Cite materials essay.

workedExamples.title: Latent handles for language
workedExamples.after: Direct manipulation of meaning (drag ‘less formal’, interpolate ideas) as a material interface to LMs.
workedExamples.body: From the latent essay: tighter feedback than chat alone. Catalog paraphrases publicly; no endorsement.

antiPatterns: Renaming screens without changing the underlying material.
Copying a metaphor’s chrome without its physics.
checklist: Job that old materials fail is explicit.
New material has named operations and constraints.
At least one borrowed metaphor’s physics are checked for fit.
Prototype exercises the material, not the marketing page.
